title: ControlProfile
description: Portable FIFA 10–12 style control profile (version 2). Canonical on-disk form uses snake_case keys; the web client converts to camelCase in memory at the boundary (host/psfc_host/web/static/control_profile.js) and the Godot client (client/scripts/input/controller_interface.gd) uses this form directly. Physical inputs map to abstract actions through two context maps: `attack` (in possession) and `defense` (out of possession). Several actions may share one physical input (Two-Button preset); `null` means unbound. The eight gameplay settings are synced to psfc-sim as the 14-bit 0x4000-tagged ControlSettings word (sim/psfc-sim/src/input.rs).

preset.description: Preset the bindings came from; any manual rebind switches it to `custom`.

auto_switch.description: AutoSwitchMode: auto = AssistedBall (0), air_balls = AirAndLoose (1), manual = Manual (2).

auto_switch_move_assist.description: AutoSwitchMoveAssist momentum carry after a switch.

defending_mode.description: FIFA 12 Tactical (contain shadows, manual timed tackle) or Legacy (contain presses + auto-tackle).

analog_sprint.description: true: sprint scales with trigger depth 0.0–1.0; false: any press past the 0.10 deadzone is full sprint.

attack.description: In Possession map: action -> physical input.

defense.description: Out of Possession map: action -> physical input.

physical_input.description: Positional physical input: south = A/✕/Nintendo B, east = B/○/Nintendo A, west = X/□/Nintendo Y, north = Y/△/Nintendo X, rt = RT/R2/ZR, rb = RB/R1/R, lt = LT/L2/ZL, lb = LB/L1/L, select = View/Share/−. Sticks are fixed: left = 360° dribble / movement, right = skill moves / manual directional switch.
